summary: Font and text code received several correctness and performance improvements: font entry locking and removal of obsolete bits make font loading safer, and font name handling was hardened so empty names are treated as missing. New behavior ensures fonts created via fontconfig get a Skrifa fallback and that webfont data is retained after sanitization, while glyph cache fields were made atomic for thread safety; about:support now reports whether the color‑management (CMS) output profile is in use.
